detail: check_scaffold.evidence calls (ROOT / path).exists() on each evidence entry; an entry like 'tests/acl2/reclaim-chunked-walk-tests.lisp (the owner fixture store ...)' raises OSError ENAMETOOLONG and the tool exits 'malformed scaffold' before any other check. Measured at dev: 709 rows, 7,346 entries; 440 rows cite something that is not a tracked file (prose, or reports under planning/evidence/ that left the tree, which D71 allows); 3 rows hold a string, not a list. make check (not check-fast, not a train gate) is red on it. The repair is the lists, rewritten through ledger.py --repoint (lane/b-ledger-evidence), and check_scaffold reporting a non-path entry as a finding instead of crashing.
title: make check's check_scaffold crashes on a proofs.json evidence entry that is prose, not a path
